title: Finite-Shear Hashin–Shtrikman Bounds and Rod–Hinge Deformations
exact_target: Find sharper or attainable finite-shear modulus bounds, and determine whether growing periodic cells approximate nonaffine rod--hinge deformations.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30005840 (OWR-14298167-007). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Mechanics of Materials: Multiscale Design of Advanced Materials and Structures (2024), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2024/11, pp. 657--730. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: The two questions are separate. Attaining a shear bound without the bulk bound and remaining optimal under finite shear are both required in the first construction alternative.
